arabic: يَا مَنْ لَا تَنْقَضِي عَجَائِبُ عَظَمَتِهِ ،
صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ،
وَ احْجُبْنَا عَنِ الْإِلْحَادِ فِي عَظَمَتِكَ
وَ يَا مَنْ لَا تَنْتَهِي مُدَّةُ مُلْكِهِ ،
صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ،
وَ أَعْتِقْ رِقَابَنَا مِنْ نَقِمَتِكَ .
وَ يَا مَنْ لَا تَفْنَى خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَتِهِ ،
صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
وَ اجْعَلْ لَنَا نَصِيباً فِي رَحْمَتِكَ .
وَ يَا مَنْ تَنْقَطِعُ دُونَ رُؤْيَتِهِ الْأَبْصَارُ
صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ،
وَ أَدْنِنَا إِلَى قُرْبِكَ
وَ يَا مَنْ تَصْغُرُ عِنْدَ خَطَرِهِ الْأَخْطَارُ ،
صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ، وَ كَرِّمْنَا عَلَيْكَ .
وَ يَا مَنْ تَظْهَرُ عِنْدَهُ بَوَاطِنُ الْأَخْبَارِ ،
صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ، وَ لَا تَفْضَحْنَا لَدَيْكَ .
اللَّهُمَّ أَغْنِنَا عَنْ هِبَةِ الْوَهَّابِينَ بِهِبَتِكَ ،
وَ اكْفِنَا وَحْشَةَ الْقَاطِعِينَ بِصِلَتِكَ
حَتَّى لَا نَرْغَبَ إِلَى أَحَدٍ مَعَ بَذْلِكَ ،
وَ لَا نَسْتَوْحِشَ مِنْ أَحَدٍ مَعَ فَضْلِكَ .
اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ،
وَ كِدْ لَنَا وَ لَا تَكِدْ عَلَيْنَا ،
وَ امْكُرْ لَنَا وَ لَا تَمْكُرْ بِنَا ،
وَ أَدِلْ لَنَا وَ لَا تُدِلْ مِنَّا .
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ،
وَ قِنَا مِنْكَ ، وَ احْفَظْنَا بِكَ ،
وَ اهْدِنَا إِلَيْكَ ، وَ لَا تُبَاعِدْنَا عَنْكَ
إِنَّ مَنْ تَقِهِ يَسْلَمْ وَ مَنْ تَهْدِهِ يَعْلَمْ ،
وَ مَنْ تُقَرِّبْهُ إِلَيْكَ يَغْنَمْ .
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ،
وَ اكْفِنَا حَدَّ نَوَائِبِ الزَّمَانِ ،
وَ شَرَّ مَصَايِدِ الشَّيْطَانِ ، وَ مَرَارَةَ صَوْلَةِ السُّلْطَانِ .
اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّمَا يَكْتَفِي الْمُكْتَفُونَ بِفَضْلِ قُوَّتِكَ ،
فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ،
وَ اكْفِنَا ،
وَ إِنَّمَا يُعْطِي الْمُعْطُونَ مِنْ فَضْلِ جِدَتِكَ ،
فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ،
وَ أَعْطِنَا ،
وَ إِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِي الْمُهْتَدُونَ بِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ ،
فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ، وَ اهْدِنَا .
اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ مَنْ وَاَلَيْتَ لَمْ يَضْرُرْهُ
خِذْلَانُ الْخَاذِلِينَ ،
وَ مَنْ أَعْطَيْتَ لَمْ يَنْقُصْهُ مَنْعُ الْمَانِعِينَ ،
وَ مَنْ هَدَيْتَ لَمْ يُغْوِهِ إِضْلَالُ الْمُضِلِّينَ
فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ،
وَ امْنَعْنَا بِعِزِّكَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ ،
وَ أَغْنِنَا عَنْ غَيْرِكَ بِإِرْفَادِكَ ،
وَ اسْلُكْ بِنَا سَبِيلَ الْحَقِّ بِإِرْشَادِكَ .
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ،
وَ اجْعَلْ سَلَامَةَ قُلُوبِنَا فِي ذِكْرِ عَظَمَتِكَ ،
وَ فَرَاغَ أَبْدَانِنَا فِي شُكْرِ نِعْمَتِكَ ،
وَ انْطِلَاقَ أَلْسِنَتِنَا فِي وَصْفِ مِنَّتِكَ .
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ،
وَ اجْعَلْنَا مِنْ دُعَاتِكَ الدَّاعِينَ إِلَيْكَ ،
وَ هُدَاتِكَ الدَّالِّينَ عَلَيْكَ ،
وَ مِنْ خَاصَّتِكَ الْخَاصِّينَ لَدَيْكَ ،
يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
transliteration: Wa yā man lā tantahī muddatu mulkih,
Wa yā man lā tafnā khazā’inu raḥmatih,
Wa yā man tanqaṭi‘u dūna ru’yatihi-l-abṣār
ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammadin wa ālih, wa karrimnā ‘alayk.
ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammadin wa ālih, wa lā tafḍaḥnā ladayk.
ḥattā lā narghaba ilā aḥadin ma‘a badhlik,
wa lā nastawḥisha min aḥadin ma‘a faḍlik.
wa kid lanā wa lā takid ‘alaynā,
wa-mkur lanā wa lā tamkur binā,
wa adil lanā wa lā tudil minnā.
inna man taqihi yaslam wa man tahdihi ya‘lam,
wa sharra maṣāyidi-sh-shayṭān, wa marārata ṣawlati-s-sulṭān.
wa innamā yu‘ṭi-l-mu‘ṭūna min faḍli jidatik,
Allāhumma innaka man wālayta lam yaḍrurhu
wa man a‘ṭayta lam yanquṣhu man‘u-l-māni‘īn,
wa man hadayta lam yughwihi iḍlālu-l-muḍillīn
wa farāgha abdāninā fī shukri ni‘matik,
translation: O He whose wonders of might never cease,
bless Muhammad and his Household,
and veil us from deviation concerning Your might.
O He whose term of kingship never ends,
bless Muhammad and his Household,
and free our necks from Your vengeance.
O He whose treasuries of mercy are never exhausted,
bless Muhammad and his Household,
and appoint for us a share in Your mercy.
O He before whose vision sights fall short,
bless Muhammad and his Household,
and bring us near to Your proximity.
O He at whose importance all other importances diminish,
bless Muhammad and his Household, and honor us with Yourself.
O He with whom the inner secrets of tidings become manifest,
bless Muhammad and his Household, and do not expose us before You.
O God, make us rich through Your gift, [sparing us] from the gifts of givers,
and suffice us against the loneliness of those who cut off [ties] through Your connection,
so that we may not desire anyone else along with Your bestowal,
and not feel desolate from anyone along with Your bounty.
O God, so bless Muhammad and his Household,
and plan for us, and do not plan against us,
and devise for us, and do not devise against us,
and grant us victory, and do not grant victory over us.
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
and protect us from Yourself, and preserve us by Yourself,
and guide us to Yourself, and do not distance us from Yourself.
Indeed, whomever You protect is safe, and whomever You guide knows,
and whomever You bring near to Yourself gains.
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
and suffice us against the sharpness of time's calamities,
and the evil of Satan's snares, and the bitterness of the sovereign's assault.
O God, the self-sufficient are only made sufficient by the bounty of Your strength,
so bless Muhammad and his Household,
and suffice us.
And givers only give from the bounty of Your generosity,
so bless Muhammad and his Household,
and give us.
And the guided are only guided by the light of Your Countenance,
so bless Muhammad and his Household, and guide us.
O God, indeed, whomever You take as an ally is not harmed
by the abandonment of the abandoners,
and whomever You give is not diminished by the withholding of the withholders,
and whomever You guide is not led astray by the misguidance of the misguiders.
So bless Muhammad and his Household,
and protect us by Your might from Your servants,
and enrich us from others through Your support,
and make us travel the path of truth through Your guidance.
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
and place the soundness of our hearts in remembering Your might,
and the leisure of our bodies in gratitude for Your blessing,
and the fluency of our tongues in describing Your favor.
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
and make us among Your callers who call to You,
and Your guides who direct to You,
and among Your elect, the chosen ones with You,
O Most Merciful of the merciful.
